status: Protocol before holdout download/evaluation; cluster7 entirely development because already viewed
choice_reason: Three small files (11,13,18 MB) selected by archive size, not policy performance
unsupported_operations: Reject cluster and report exclusion; do not choose a replacement based on results
initial_state: All policies start with 4 shards, identical trace-derived inventory, empty service queue, no active migration. This models an idle queue at deployment; not continuous production state.
work_scenario: get=1, set=2, plus reported key+value bytes/4096; not measured CPU costs
capacity_scenario: mean incoming work/(4*0.65) on calibration window
bandwidth_scenario: median live inventory/8 bytes per slot; source service capacity reduced by 20% at full transfer rate
service: Per-key fluid queue, proportional service within each shard; backlog survives cutover. Not per-request latency or FIFO SLA.
migration: Snapshot bytes at start + all subsequent full write bytes for moving keys; background bounded transfer, source routing until atomic end-of-slot cutover. Ignore expiry cancellation conservatively. No abort; commands during migration ignored.
objectives: All policies selected by mean validation model cost (server + transfer + queue + terminal liabilities). Also disclose queue metrics; no hard safety guarantee.
checkpoints: Final only; no validation early stopping
budget_reporting: Equal transitions, seeds, candidate count and validation calls across RL families. Baselines get exhaustive grid; report time separately, never equate configs with compute.
inference: Three distinct clusters, descriptive per-cluster results only; no claimed population confidence interval or independence from shared infrastructure
no_retuning: Freeze source and selected weights with SHA256 before loading holdout; report every prespecified cluster or explicit parser failure. Holdout outcomes cannot change selected policies in this version.
model_selection: Minimum mean validation cost across all three folds and seeds per candidate; deploy predeclared seed7, report all selected-candidate seeds
holdout_sensitivity: Frozen policies replayed at 0.5 and 2 times calibrated capacity, then separately bandwidth; do not choose policy using these outcomes
